comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Hidden Value of Orichalcum Memorial Album, this weapon requires the following to create it:

Blitz + Orichalcum x1 + Check (10 million㌦) x5 + Special Purchase Bond x5
Rank 13 Alchemy + Casting skills
Completion of the "Egypt & Atlantis" story quest from the Atlantis chain to unlock Transmutation Alchemy

Throwing Knife-type weapon
Throwing +1
Assault +1
Evasion +1
40k total fame to equip
EX Effect: Increase land speed Rank 3

Further details available on their respective pages. Cheers.
